versions.artifact_text:
Launch with shared accountability.

A Web3 project page prepared by an agent, reviewed by a partner, and published with a receipt.

Our release commitment

  • Every content change creates a new version and requires a new reviewer approval.
  • Authorize one publication attempt.
  • Keep the delivered evidence.

Delivery evidence

  1. Original files and the executor signature: check package consistency.
  2. Confirmed chain receipt: check the approved version and execution attempt.
  3. Downloaded artifact: compare its bytes with the approved file.

File equality and the executor statement do not establish business quality. Tests and human review assess quality.

manifest.summary: Apply signed reviewer feedback: explicit reapproval and independent evidence checks
test_evidence: Agent verified the designated reviewer EIP-712 signature, content digest, exact v2 manifest and confirmed correction transaction.

Acceptance checks passed: changed contents require new approval; originals/signature, chain receipt and downloaded bytes are separate checks; business quality remains subject to tests and human review.
Static check: valid UTF-8, HTML parser, 32 KiB limit, no scripts, forms or external resource URLs.
